get_account.title: Get account balance
get_account.description: Get the account email and credit balance: credits_left, credits_monthly and credits_spent. Use it to check the key works and how many lookups remain before running paid lookups.

output.description: credits_left, credits_monthly, credits_spent, email and status.

lookup_phone.title: Look up spam score and caller ID
lookup_phone.description: Look up a phone number's spam score (0-100), reputation, complaint evidence, entity type and business caller name (CNAM) from listings in 195 countries. Set hlr=true to add live carrier info (LRN, OCN, line type, ported flag). For carrier data only use lookup_network; for porting use get_ported_date or get_porting_history.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164, e.g. +18179208058 (digits without the + are also accepted).

hlr.description: Also perform an HLR/carrier lookup and return carrier_info.

output.description: data (spam_score, reputation, entity_type, business_info, carrier_info, complaints...) and status.

lookup_network.title: Look up live carrier (HLR)
lookup_network.description: Run a live HLR/network lookup for a number: live status, number type (mobile, landline, VoIP), original and current network with MCC/MNC, ported flag and ported date. Use lookup_phone when you also need the spam score or caller name.
lookup_network.notes: Documented on https://callerapi.com/carrier-lookup-api. One credit per lookup.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164, e.g. +18179208058 (digits without the + are also accepted).

output.description: data with live_status, telephone_number_type, original_network_details, current_network_details, is_ported, ported_date, timestamp.

get_did_reputation.title: Check DID reputation
get_did_reputation.description: Check one phone number (DID) against 12 reputation sources and return which ones flagged it, with each source's label, complaint count and dates, so you know where to request remediation. A clean source has no key in the spam map.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164, e.g. +18179208058 (digits without the + are also accepted).

output.description: data with phone and spam: one key per flagging source (e.g. callerapi: is_spam, complaints_count, last_complaint_on).

get_ported_date.title: Get last ported date
get_ported_date.description: Get whether a phone number has been ported and its most recent port date (exact or estimated), a SIM-swap / account-takeover signal. Use get_porting_history for every past port.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164, e.g. +18179208058 (digits without the + are also accepted).

get_porting_history.title: Get porting history
get_porting_history.description: Get every past porting event of a phone number with dates and carriers. Use get_ported_date when only the latest port matters (cheaper).

phone.description: Phone number in E.164, e.g. +18179208058 (digits without the + are also accepted).

output.description: The number's porting history and status.

get_online_presence.title: Get online presence
get_online_presence.description: Check which online services a phone number is registered with (WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, Google, Amazon, LinkedIn, Office365, Skype, Twitter, Viber and more). Each service is 1 (registered), 0 (not) or -1 (unknown).

phone.description: Phone number in E.164, e.g. +18179208058 (digits without the + are also accepted).

output.description: online_presence: map of service name to 1, 0 or -1.

verify_kyc_identity.title: Verify identity against carrier (KYC)
verify_kyc_identity.description: Match a user's name, date of birth, address and email against the mobile operator's subscriber records for a phone number. Each field returns a score: 100 exact, 75-99 strong, 50-74 partial, 1-49 weak, 0 no match, -1 carrier has no data.
verify_kyc_identity.notes: Billed per lookup (EUR 0.30). Handles personal data.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164, e.g. +18179208058 (digits without the + are also accepted).

dob.description: Date of birth as day, month and year strings, e.g. {"day":"1","month":"12","year":"1999"}.

address.description: street, street_no, unit_no, city, state, postcode and country (ISO code) strings.

email.description: Email address of the user being verified.

output.description: Per-field match scores against carrier records and status.

get_signer_reputation.title: Get STIR/SHAKEN signer reputation
get_signer_reputation.description: Get what the Falcon network has seen of a STIR/SHAKEN signer by its Service Provider Code over the last 7 days: score 0-100 from failed verifications, rejects and spam database hits. Use list_signer_reputation to rank all signers.

spc.description: Service Provider Code from the TNAuthList extension of the signing certificate; four digits for US carriers, up to 16 characters.

list_signer_reputation.title: List signers ranked by score
list_signer_reputation.description: List STIR/SHAKEN signers (by Service Provider Code) ranked by reputation score, optionally only those at or above a minimum score. Use get_signer_reputation for one SPC.

limit.description: How many signers to return (max 500, default 50).

min_score.description: Only signers scoring at least this (0-100, default 0).

output.description: status, window_days and data: the ranked signers.

verify_calling_number.title: Verify a business calling number
verify_calling_number.description: Business Caller ID check at call setup: ask whether the registered owner of the calling number announced this exact call to this callee. Verdict is verified (show name, mark and logo), spoofed (recommended action drop) or unverified.

from.description: Calling number as presented to the switch, in E.164.

to.description: Called number, in E.164; the announcement is bound to it.

assertion.description: Compact JWS the switch received in-band (e.g. in a SIP header), checked against CallerAPI's announcements. Never a publish token.

output.description: The verdict, recommended action and, when verified, the identity (name, logo_id).

scan_call.title: Score a call transcript or recording
scan_call.description: Classify one finished call as scam or not from its transcript or base64 audio (exactly one). Returns a score 0-1, level (clean, suspicious, likely_scam, scam), complaint category, tactics, extracted intel and the transcript. With report=true and from, a score of 0.8+ files the caller as a complaint.
scan_call.notes: 2 credits per request plus 1 per started minute of audio; times out after 90 s.

transcript.description: Text of the call. Give this or audio_base64.

audio_base64.description: Base64 audio of the call. Give this or transcript. Body limit 25 MB.

encoding.description: Audio encoding: wav (needs RIFF header), pcm16 (16-bit LE, needs sample_rate) or mulaw (8000 Hz default).

sample_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz; required for pcm16.

from.description: Caller number in E.164 with a leading +. Required for report.

report.description: File the caller as a complaint when the score is 0.8 or more.

output.description: The verdict (score, level, category, tactics, summary), the intel and the transcript, plus the session id.

list_voice_sessions.title: List voice firewall sessions
list_voice_sessions.description: List this key's recent voice firewall sessions (live filter, honeypot and scan), newest first, with caller, callee, duration, score, level, category, summary and whether the number was reported. Use get_voice_session for the full verdict and intel.

get_voice_session.title: Get a voice firewall session
get_voice_session.description: Get one voice firewall session with its full verdict and extracted intel as objects. Use it to recover a missed webhook event or answer a dispute about a blocked call.

session_id.description: The session_id (UUID) from an event, list_voice_sessions or scan_call.

output.description: The session record with verdict and intel.

get_voice_capabilities.title: Get voice firewall capabilities
get_voice_capabilities.description: Report which voice firewall products are enabled for this key (live_filter, honeypot, scan) and the credit prices in force. live_filter must be true before opening the live filter stream.

list_verdict_categories.title: List verdict categories
list_verdict_categories.description: List every value a voice firewall verdict.category can take, with a description. They are the CallerAPI complaint subjects also used by lookup_phone; `none` means a clean call.

list_honeypot_personas.title: List honeypot personas
list_honeypot_personas.description: List the personas the voice honeypot can use to keep scammers talking. Pass a persona id as the persona option on a honeypot voice URL to use one character on every call.

preview_filter_twiml.title: Preview screened-number TwiML
preview_filter_twiml.description: Return the TwiML that the Twilio screened-number voice URL would serve for these options (forks caller audio to the live scam filter and dials forward). Use it to check the XML before setting /api/voice/filter/twiml as a Twilio number's voice URL.

forward.description: E.164 number the screened call should ring, e.g. +15551234567.

webhook.description: HTTPS URL that receives verdict events. HTTP URLs are ignored.

report.description: `true` files the caller and every callback number as a complaint when the final level is scam. Default false.

tracks.description: `both` also transcribes the called party (labelled callee); transcription cost doubles. Default is the caller only.

get_daily_spam_reports.title: Fetch daily spam reports
get_daily_spam_reports.description: Fetch today's validated spam complaints for one country, page by page: each with phone number, created and violation dates, consumer state, subject, robocall flag and comment. Use get_spam_csv_snapshot for the full 15-day list.
get_daily_spam_reports.notes: Only enabled for CallerAPI enterprise (flat-fee feed) clients; other keys are refused.

country_code.description: Country to fetch (EN is the United Kingdom).

output.description: data with complaints, date, next_update and paging info; status.

get_spam_csv_snapshot.title: Download 15-day spam CSV
get_spam_csv_snapshot.description: Download the full snapshot of verified spam reports from the last 15 days as CSV, for a local blocklist. Large; use get_daily_spam_reports to page through one country's daily reports instead.
get_spam_csv_snapshot.notes: Only enabled for CallerAPI enterprise (flat-fee feed) clients; other keys are refused.

list_report_webhooks.title: List daily report webhooks
list_report_webhooks.description: List the webhook subscriptions that receive the daily spam reports, with their metadata. Use subscribe_report_webhook to add one.
list_report_webhooks.notes: Only enabled for CallerAPI enterprise (flat-fee feed) clients; other keys are refused.

subscribe_report_webhook.title: Subscribe a daily report webhook
subscribe_report_webhook.description: Subscribe an HTTPS URL to receive the daily spam reports by webhook instead of polling get_daily_spam_reports. Use test_report_webhook first to check your endpoint parses the payload.
subscribe_report_webhook.notes: Only enabled for CallerAPI enterprise (flat-fee feed) clients; other keys are refused.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the daily spam-report webhook posts.

unsubscribe_report_webhook.title: Unsubscribe a daily report webhook
unsubscribe_report_webhook.description: Remove a webhook URL from the daily spam reports subscription so it stops receiving posts. Use list_report_webhooks to see current subscriptions.
unsubscribe_report_webhook.notes: Only enabled for CallerAPI enterprise (flat-fee feed) clients; other keys are refused.

url.description: The subscribed webhook URL to remove.

test_report_webhook.title: Send a test report webhook
test_report_webhook.description: Send a sample complaints list to a URL so you can verify your backend parses the daily spam report webhook. Does not subscribe the URL.
test_report_webhook.notes: Only enabled for CallerAPI enterprise (flat-fee feed) clients; other keys are refused.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the daily spam-report webhook posts.

dispatch_report_webhooks.title: Dispatch today's report webhooks
dispatch_report_webhooks.description: Manually trigger delivery of today's spam reports to every subscribed webhook, e.g. after fixing an endpoint that missed the scheduled post.
dispatch_report_webhooks.notes: Only enabled for CallerAPI enterprise (flat-fee feed) clients; other keys are refused.

upload_spam_reports.title: Upload spam reports
upload_spam_reports.description: Upload up to 1000 spam complaints to the CallerAPI database as a data partner. Each report needs PhoneNumber, CreatedDate, ViolationDate, ConsumerState, Subject (a CallerAPI complaint subject, see list_verdict_categories), RecordedMessageOrRobocall and Comment.
upload_spam_reports.notes: Only enabled for approved CallerAPI data partners.

reports.description: Complaints (max 1000), each {PhoneNumber, CreatedDate (UTC timestamp), ViolationDate (UTC timestamp), ConsumerState, Subject, RecordedMessageOrRobocall (Y/N), Comment}.

upload_contacts.title: Upload contacts
upload_contacts.description: Upload up to 1000 address-book contacts (phone number, name, optional email) for one of your app's users to the CallerAPI database as a data partner.
upload_contacts.notes: Only enabled for approved CallerAPI data partners.

external_user_id.description: Your id for the user whose contacts these are.
